changelog: Client installers are scoped per endpoint rather than restricted to administrators. 3.2.105 gated them on role because the installer embeds an endpoint's internet auth key; they are now gated on the endpoint itself, so a read-only account can install an agent on its own customer's endpoints and is refused for anyone else's.

Downloading an installer no longer fetches the endpoint's auth key in the browser. The backend already resolved the key itself and ignored the one the page sent, so that call was redundant — and it raced its own state update. Revealing the raw key in the UI stays administrator-only.
Includes 3.2.110: removing or demoting a user takes effect immediately.

Includes 3.2.105-3.2.109: user roles scoped to customers (issue #21), migrations shipped through the update channel, Bare Metal Restore scoped per endpoint, VHD export fixed, and unrestorable images kept out of the restore picker.
